info.bio: Formados en Chapel Hill, North Carolina en 1989, Superchunk puede considerarse como una de las bandas mas emblemáticas del indie rock americano de los 90's. Siempre siguiendo sus propias reglas, abanderando la ética D.I.Y., ignorando y rechazando las modas de la industria musical para permanecer fieles a su sonido y a su libertad artística, Superchunk pasó por algunos de los sellos mas significativos del underground americano, hasta que formaron uno propio: Merge Records

scenes.name: Hardcore en la era del punk-pop: emocore, ska-core y post-hardcore
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Mientras las revistas anuncian la «muerte del punk», el hardcore se convierte en un movimiento que no deja pueblo sin tocar y genera subgéneros. El «emocore» (Jawbreaker, Weezer, Sunny Day Real Estate, Promise Ring, At The Drive-In, Jimmy Eat World, Seaweed); el hardcore progresivo de Washington (Nation Of Ulysses, Make-Up, Shudder To Think, Jawbox, Edsel, Lungfish, Circus Lupus, Dismemberment Plan); el «ska-core» (Operation Ivy, Rancid, Mighty Mighty Bosstones, Sublime, No Doubt); el punk-pop que llega a las listas (Green Day, Offspring, Flop, Pennywise, Pegboy, Superchunk, Queers); el garage-punk californiano (Drive Like Jehu, Rocket From The Crypt, Blink 182, Zen Guerrilla); el jazzcore (Bazooka, Iceburn); la vieja escuela (D Generation, Supersuckers, Zeke, Dropkick Murphys, Silverfish, Turbonegro) y el post-hardcore de Unwound.

podcast.title: Formation of Merge Records (1989)
podcast.body: Members of the independent band SuperChunk formed Merge Records in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, in 1989. The band established the label due to dissatisfaction with the major label system, and it eventually found significant success with acts like Arcade Fire after struggling for years. "Merge Records was formed by a couple of members of an independent band called SuperChunk in Chapel Hill, North Carolina back in 1989."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Founders of Merge Records (1989)
podcast.body: Two members from the band Superchunk established Merge Records in 1989 after experiencing difficulty finding a major label or subsidiary willing to release their music, leading them to create their own company. "The company was established in 1989 by two people from a band called SuperChunk, and theirs was the same story that we've heard again and again. They couldn't find any major or major label subsidiary to release their music, so they just created their own company and did it themselves."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
